text: Returns window: unused items in their original packaging can be returned within 30 days of delivery.
Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 7 business days after the returned item has been inspected.
Items marked Final Sale cannot be returned or exchanged.
Return shipping is free for defective items. For all other returns the customer pays a flat 8 USD shipping fee, deducted from the refund.
Warranty: tents and backpacks are covered for 2 years against manufacturing defects. Footwear is covered for 1 year. Normal wear and tear is excluded.
Warranty claims require proof of purchase and photos of the defect. A decision is given within 5 business days.
Exception: returns made after 30 days and up to 60 days are accepted as store credit only, and must be approved by a Support Manager.
Any refund above 500 USD also requires approval from Finance, in addition to the Support Manager.
Gift purchases: refunds go to the gift giver's payment method. If the recipient presents a gift receipt, they receive store credit instead.
Items damaged in transit must be reported within 48 hours with photos. A replacement is shipped at no cost and the damaged item does not need to be returned.
